parameters.subject: Formal Job Offer - Congratulations! 🎉
parameters.message:
Congratulations on Your Job Offer! 🏆

Dear Candidate,

Following your impressive interview performance and dossier evaluation, we are thrilled to formally extend an offer of employment to you.

Our HR Operations team will reach out to you within 24 hours with the detailed contract, compensation package, and onboarding checklist.

We are very excited about the prospect of having you join our team!

Warm regards,
Talent Acquisition & Leadership Team

parameters.subject: Update on your application with our team
parameters.message:
Thank you for your time and interest

Dear Candidate,

Thank you very much for taking the time to speak with our team and for your interest in the position.

While your background is impressive, we have decided to move forward with another candidate whose experience more closely matches our immediate requirements.

We sincerely appreciate the effort and enthusiasm you shared with us and wish you the absolute best in your future career endeavors.

Sincerely,
Talent Acquisition Team
